center.name: DLJ-ACT-01
center.notes: Active well currently drilling 12-1/4" hole in Tipam; planned TD 3,650 m in Kopili. 2 incidents logged so far (8.5 hrs NPT).

wells.name: DLJ-36
wells.notes: Deviated well drilled to 3,090 m TD (Barail); 2 recorded incidents, 21 hrs NPT. Notable: High torque spike at 1,720 m in Girujan.

key_events.description: Torque spike to 13.3 kft-lb at 1,720 m MD (Girujan); string stalled twice before parameters were reduced.
key_events.mitigation: Lowered RPM, added lubricant to mud system and reamed the interval before drilling ahead.
key_events.lesson_learned: Wiper trips every 150 m in Girujan reduce pack-off and torque spikes.

key_events.description: Cement top found 187 m below plan behind 13-3/8" casing at 958 m MD (Dhekiajuli).
key_events.mitigation: Top job carried out through annulus; casing pressure-tested to 4000 psi.
key_events.lesson_learned: Run CBL after every Dhekiajuli cement job; remedial squeeze if bond is poor.

wells.name: DLJ-52
wells.notes: Vertical well drilled to 3,585 m TD (Kopili); 3 recorded incidents, 34 hrs NPT. Notable: High stuck pipe at 3,139 m in Barail.

key_events.description: Differential sticking at 3,139 m MD across Barail; unable to rotate or reciprocate. MW 10.7 ppg.
key_events.mitigation: Reduced MW slightly to lower differential pressure, worked pipe free and conditioned hole with hi-vis sweeps.
key_events.lesson_learned: Avoid static pipe across Barail coal seams; keep pipe moving during connections.

key_events.description: CBL/VDL indicated poor cement bond behind 9-5/8" casing from 2,272 to 2,869 m MD across Tipam; channelling suspected.
key_events.mitigation: Top job carried out through annulus; casing pressure-tested to 4000 psi.
key_events.lesson_learned: Two-stage cementing recommended where Tipam losses occur.

key_events.description: Sudden loss of returns at 142 m MD in Alluvium; loss rate 18 bbl/hr. Standpipe pressure dropped 164 psi.
key_events.mitigation: Reduced mud weight by 0.2 ppg and spotted a cross-linked LCM pill across the loss zone.
key_events.lesson_learned: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Alluvium loss zone.

wells.name: DLJ-21
wells.notes: Deviated well drilled to 2,980 m TD (Barail); 4 recorded incidents, 67 hrs NPT. Notable: High fishing at 2,198 m in Tipam.

key_events.description: Bit cone lost at 2,198 m MD (Tipam); junk basket and magnet runs required.
key_events.mitigation: Fishing assembly run with jar and bumper sub; fish recovered on second attempt.
key_events.lesson_learned: Avoid excessive overpull in Tipam; string failures occurred at connections.

key_events.description: Hole enlargement indicated by caliper across Girujan at 1,667 m MD; MW 9.6 ppg considered marginal.
key_events.mitigation: Raised MW by 0.3 ppg, minimised open-hole time and controlled tripping speeds.
key_events.lesson_learned: Control trip speeds to reduce surge/swab in Girujan.

key_events.description: Partial losses of 4 bbl/hr observed while drilling Tipam at 2,103 m MD with 9.7 ppg mud. Pit volume decreased 36 bbl before losses were controlled.
key_events.mitigation: Pumped 36 ppb LCM pill (fine/medium) and reduced flow rate to lower ECD; losses cured after 5.9 hrs.
key_events.lesson_learned: Pre-treat mud with LCM before entering Tipam sands; keep pills staged on surface.

wells.name: DLJ-03
wells.notes: Deviated well drilled to 3,535 m TD (Kopili); 7 recorded incidents, 81 hrs NPT. Notable: High kick at 3,437 m in Kopili.

key_events.description: Well kicked at 3,437 m MD on entering Kopili; pit gain 124 bbl, SIDPP 413 psi, SICP 849 psi. Gas units peaked at 1258.
key_events.mitigation: Well shut in; recorded SIDPP 413 psi. Weighted up to 13.3 ppg using wait-and-weight method before resuming drilling.
key_events.lesson_learned: Narrow window in Kopili: manage ECD carefully to avoid losses while holding the kick off.

key_events.description: Torque increased sharply from 10.6 to 16.0 kft-lb at 3,236 m MD while drilling Barail; ROP dropped and stick-slip observed.
key_events.mitigation: Pulled to shoe, changed to a stabilised BHA and resumed drilling at controlled parameters.
key_events.lesson_learned: Wiper trips every 150 m in Barail reduce pack-off and torque spikes.

key_events.description: Large cavings at shakers while drilling Barail at 3,132 m MD; erratic torque and fill on bottom after trip.
key_events.mitigation: Increased mud inhibition and reduced surge/swab by slower trips; cavings reduced within 12 hrs.
key_events.lesson_learned: Minimise open-hole time in Barail; shale destabilises within days.

wells.name: DLJ-12
wells.notes: Deviated well drilled to 3,480 m TD (Kopili); 5 recorded incidents, 87 hrs NPT. Notable: High tight hole at 1,659 m in Girujan.

key_events.description: Drag increased to 94 klbs at 1,659 m MD across Girujan clays; back-reamed to shoe.
key_events.mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (KCl) to reduce clay swelling.
key_events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Girujan; do not wait for drag to increase.

key_events.description: Pipe became stuck while making connection at 2,940 m MD in Barail shale/coal sequence. Overpull to 85 klbs, no rotation. Worked pipe with jarring for 4.5 hrs; freed after spotting 30 bbl lubricant pill. Torque had risen from 9 to 14 kft-lb over the preceding 60 m.
key_events.mitigation: Increased circulation before connections; short reaming intervals; improved hole conditioning with hi-vis sweeps.
key_events.lesson_learned: Rising torque trend in upper Barail is a precursor to stuck pipe; ream every stand and keep jars armed below 2,900 m.

key_events.description: Restricted movement after connection at 1,529 m MD (Girujan); reamed stand three times.
key_events.mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (KCl) to reduce clay swelling.
key_events.lesson_learned: Hole cleaning limits ROP in Girujan; drill at a controlled rate.

wells.name: DLJ-45
wells.notes: Deviated well drilled to 3,260 m TD (Barail); 6 recorded incidents, 58 hrs NPT. Notable: High tight hole at 1,810 m in Girujan.

key_events.description: Restricted movement after connection at 1,810 m MD (Girujan); reamed stand three times.
key_events.mitigation: Reamed on every connection and improved hole cleaning with higher flow rate.
key_events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Girujan; do not wait for drag to increase.

key_events.description: Partial losses of 47 bbl/hr observed while drilling Tipam at 2,556 m MD with 9.9 ppg mud. Pit volume decreased 152 bbl before losses were controlled.
key_events.mitigation: Staged LCM (calcium carbonate + fibre) and drilled ahead at reduced pump rate with continuous pit monitoring.
key_events.lesson_learned: Reduce ECD (lower flow, controlled ROP) when approaching the Tipam loss zone.

key_events.description: String stuck at 1,757 m MD (Girujan) after 30 min static during survey. Overpull 70 klbs.
key_events.mitigation: Worked pipe with jars for 6.1 hrs, spotted 34 bbl lubricant pill and freed string; reamed interval twice.
key_events.lesson_learned: Rising torque trend in upper Girujan is a precursor to stuck pipe; ream every stand and keep jars armed.

wells.name: DLJ-41
wells.notes: Vertical well drilled to 4,300 m TD (Basement); 7 recorded incidents, 93 hrs NPT. Notable: High wellbore instability at 3,947 m in Langpar.

key_events.description: Shale instability at 3,947 m MD in Langpar; 182 bbl of cavings circulated out over 24 hrs.
key_events.mitigation: Increased mud inhibition and reduced surge/swab by slower trips; cavings reduced within 12 hrs.
key_events.lesson_learned: Slightly higher MW in Langpar reduces cavings without inducing losses.

key_events.description: Pipe became stuck while making connection at 1,745 m MD in Girujan. Overpull to 93 klbs, no rotation. Torque had risen from 7.9 to 11.9 kft-lb over the preceding 60 m.

key_events.description: Sudden loss of returns at 2,827 m MD in Tipam; loss rate 21 bbl/hr. Standpipe pressure dropped 198 psi.

wells.name: DLJ-29
wells.notes: Deviated well drilled to 3,260 m TD (Barail); 11 recorded incidents, 315 hrs NPT. Notable: Critical fishing at 1,846 m in Girujan.

key_events.description: BHA parted at connection while drilling Girujan at 1,846 m MD; overshot run to recover.
key_events.mitigation: Milled over fish, recovered with spear and resumed drilling with new bit.
key_events.lesson_learned: Inspect BHA connections before running through hard Girujan stringers.

key_events.description: Torque increased sharply from 11.1 to 20.9 kft-lb at 3,002 m MD while drilling Barail; ROP dropped and stick-slip observed.
key_events.mitigation: Reduced WOB/RPM, circulated bottoms-up and performed wiper trip to condition the hole.
key_events.lesson_learned: Wiper trips every 150 m in Barail reduce pack-off and torque spikes.

key_events.description: Twist-off at 2,966 m MD in Barail; fish length 73 m left in hole. Fishing operations 7.0 hrs.
key_events.mitigation: Fishing assembly run with jar and bumper sub; fish recovered on second attempt.
key_events.lesson_learned: Inspect BHA connections before running through hard Barail stringers.

wells.name: DLJ-07
wells.notes: Deviated well drilled to 3,560 m TD (Sylhet); 6 recorded incidents, 114 hrs NPT. Notable: Critical kick at 3,112 m in Kopili.

key_events.description: Well kicked at 3,112 m MD on entering Kopili shale; pit gain 18 bbl, SIDPP 620 psi, SICP 780 psi. Gas units peaked at 1,450. Influx circulated out via driller's method.
key_events.mitigation: Shut in well on annular preventer, circulated kick out via driller's method and raised MW from 12.1 to 13.0 ppg.
key_events.lesson_learned: Raise MW before the Kopili transition; overpressure onset is sharp in this field.

key_events.description: Restricted movement after connection at 1,478 m MD (Girujan); reamed stand three times.
key_events.mitigation: Performed wiper trip to shoe and drilled ahead with increased YP mud.
key_events.lesson_learned: Ream on connections through Girujan; do not wait for drag to increase.

key_events.description: Partial losses of 22 bbl/hr observed while drilling Sylhet at 3,515 m MD with 12.3 ppg mud. Pit volume decreased 204 bbl before losses were controlled.
key_events.mitigation: Reduced mud weight by 0.2 ppg and spotted a cross-linked LCM pill across the loss zone.

key_events.description: Pipe became stuck while making connection at 2,951 m MD in Barail. Overpull to 86 klbs, no rotation. Torque had risen from 12.3 to 18.5 kft-lb over the preceding 60 m.
key_events.mitigation: Applied controlled overpull to 86 klbs, spotted pipe-freeing agent and regained rotation after 14.2 hrs.
key_events.lesson_learned: Avoid static pipe across Barail coal seams; keep pipe moving during connections.

key_events.description: Seepage to partial losses (26 bbl/hr) encountered in Tipam sands at 2,101 m MD; total loss 81 bbl.

key_events.lesson_learned: Hole cleaning limits ROP in Namsang; drill at a controlled rate.
